GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: ider Harry Grace said he had no firm instructions other than to help the gelding begin well after its awkward start at Avoca. The horse began cleanly but was caught wide without cover early. To avoid being posted wide, Grace allowed the gelding to stride forward in an attempt to cross to the rail and lead. Approaching the 1000 metres, he believed he could cross Min Kiata to secure the rail. However, Min Kiata continued to improve to his inside, preventing him from crossing, and he was forced to maintain a position to the outside for remainder of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, got its head up and lost ground (3L). Approaching 900m shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider. Commenced to race keenly in the middle stages, getting its head up on several occasions. R EX after beginning awkwardly and losing ground, settled further back than intended and then raced very greenly through the early stages before commencing to overrace. passing the 500m he was mindful of the gelding’s racing manners and for this reason, he did not place his mount under full pressure until straightening near the 250m where it ran to the line in an encouraging manner
